summary: Snatcher entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Snatcher
entries.definitive_edition: Sega CD English release for English playthrough; Japanese versions separately for revision comparison

emulation.emulator: Sega CD emulator optional for primary
emulation.notes: Use owned media/BIOS where required and document emulator/video/audio settings.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Sega CD hardware for English route; Japanese source hardware for original-version comparison

primary.why: Snatcher's original Japanese computer versions are historically important, but the Sega CD release is the main official English route and the practical archive target for an English-language playthrough. Japanese PC Engine, PlayStation, and Saturn versions should be logged separately if comparing content/censorship/localization differences.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Sega CD English release on original hardware or accurate emulation with owned media. Record region, hardware/emulator, audio/video settings, light-gun/controller setup if relevant, act/chapter, deaths/choices, and whether Japanese PC Engine or later PlayStation/Saturn versions were compared.

secondary.why: They are the earliest forms, but not the English route.

secondary.platform: PC Engine CD / PlayStation / Saturn Japanese versions
secondary.exclusive_content: Japanese CD and later console revisions
secondary.what_to_play: Use for content, censorship, and presentation comparison.
secondary.why: The Sega CD release is the English primary route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record region/version and do not merge fan translations or later Japanese revisions with the official English Sega CD route.
